svg.title: The 2024 cyclone season bloomed late
svg.desc: Twenty-nine cyclone lifetimes form a radial calendar. Angle is date, angular width is duration, radius is peak wind, and colour is peak intensity.
svg.text: LUPI EDITORIAL · L10 RADIAL PATCHWORK · PALM
Angle = calendar date · petal width = track duration · reach = peak wind · colour = peak intensity
